answer: Naturally decaying identity bonds block fake identities. An agent posts a 100-credit bond losing 5 credits each idle epoch, so hoarded identities bleed value. Renewal needs work: auditing shale samples, grading a walnut shipment, or inspecting a spiral drill, each checked by a peer. Faking 100 identities costs 10,000 credits plus 500 per idle epoch, above any reward. Honest agents pay once, work one job per epoch, and keep undiluted rewards.
